annotations.title: Save the client record for a site

description: Saves who a site is for and where things stand: business name, contact name/email/phone, the source pages its facts came from, status (prospect, pitched, managed, declined, transferred_out) and notes. Only the fields you pass change; null clears one. list_sites shows each site's record.

business_name.description: The client business name. Null clears it.

contact_name.description: The person to talk to at the business. Null clears it.

draft_token.description: The draft token returned by draft_create, if you are working on an anonymous draft. Only needed when your client cannot send the x-pagetool-draft-token header.

notes.description: Free-text notes (max 5000 chars). Null clears them.

site_key.description: The site the record is about. Defaults to the caller's current draft site when omitted.

source_urls.description: The business's own pages the site's facts came from (http/https, max 20). Replaces the stored list.

name: set_client_record
title: Save the client record for a site
